responsibility: Declares the fundamental Rust name-resolution infrastructure shared by all resolver passes. It defines Rib and Scope for namespace-specific lexical stacks keyed by CanonicalPath, plus the central Resolver singleton that owns name/type/label/macro scopes, resolved-use maps, builtin-type registration, current module tracking, rib lookup helpers, and closure-capture metadata, making this header the stateful backbone that the AST resolvers manipulate.
same_name_distinction: Declares the core resolver data structures and APIs—Rib, Scope, and the Resolver singleton with namespace scopes, rib maps, resolved-name/type/label/macro tables, module-scope stack, and closure-capture accessors. It differs from rust-name-resolver.cc by serving as the shared type/interface definition that other resolve passes include, without the method implementations.
